# Code of Conduct

This project adopts the **Contributor Covenant**, version 2.1.

The full text is published and maintained at:
<https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/>

By participating in this project — issues, pull requests, discussions,
or any other contribution channel — you agree to abide by its terms.

## Reporting

Report concerns privately to the maintainer through one of:

- The email listed on the maintainer's GitHub profile
- A [private GitHub Security Advisory](https://github.com/WhiteMuush/Medusa/security/advisories/new)
  (also acceptable for non-vulnerability conduct reports — mark the
  advisory clearly so it can be re-routed)

Reports will be handled confidentially. The maintainer reserves the
right to remove, edit, or reject contributions that do not align with
the Contributor Covenant.
